title: Zzestful French Sushi Rice Mini-Pilaf
description: A spicy, pillowy rice dish infused with Provence flavors, designed to aid in hangover recovery and suitable for diabetics. Prep cooked in a mini-cocotte.

ingredients.name: 1/2 cup finely diced red bell pepper

instructions: Rinse sushi rice in cold water, drain well.
Combine rinsed rice with 2 cups water and saffron threads. Bring to a boil then reduce heat to simmer for about 30 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
In a separate pan, toast garlic and red pepper until soft and fragrant, approximately 5 minutes.
Add toasted garlic and red bell peppers to the rice mixture along with capers and lemon zest. Mix well.
Season with cayenne pepper and turmeric powder. Stir in more water if necessary for desired consistency.
Transfer the cooked rice into individual mini-cocottes, pressing gently to form a flat base.
